newsitem.title: DUBAI: AEI UAE unit in Emirates logistics deal.
newsitem.headline: AEI UAE unit in Emirates logistics deal.

text.p: Air Express International's (AEI) United Arab Emirates (UAE) joint venture has signed a three-year deal with the Dubai government-owned Emirates Group to provide worldwide logistics.
AEI said in a statement it would co-ordinate air and sea freight, customs clearance and ground transportation for the group's procurement and logistics department from suppliers around the world.
"AEI Emirates will be responsible for managing the flow of goods and information across a global supply chain linking the Emirates Group to its suppliers," it said.
The deal covers all supplies, ranging from on-board cutlery to beverages for the group, which includes Emirates airline and Dubai airport handler and travel management company DNATA.
AEI officials declined to give the deal's value.

"Our objective is to reduce the transportation cost for Emirates by moving slow items through ocean freight and assembling goods at major AEI gateways for consolidation," AEI Emirates manager Paul Lattouf said.
AEI said it would be installing its logistics management information system, LOGIS, on site at Emirates Dubai offices.
